Experience the joy of discovery with this bundle of educational rock and gem collections. Included are two sets: the Scholastic Ultimate Rocks & Gems Collection, featuring a colorful and clearly labeled display of 48 assorted stonessuch as amethyst, rose quartz, pyrite, obsidian, lapis lazuli, and morein both rough and polished forms; and the K12 Advanced Rock & Mineral Collection, presented in a simple, compartmentalized box with assorted mineral and rock samples, each individually stored for easy examination. Both sets are excellent for educational or beginner-level collecting, making them perfect for classrooms, aspiring geologists, or hobbyists eager to explore the world of minerals and gemstones. Please note these pre-owned sets may have some missing samples, as noted, but still provide a vibrant introduction to geology.
